blocks.title: AliExpress codes & offers
blocks.intro: Every offer below comes from AliExpress's official affiliate programme. Tap Get code to unlock and copy it.

sections.h2: How to use a AliExpress promo code
sections.html:
1. Pick an offer above and tap Get code. The first time, enter your email and mobile to unlock codes, then copy it (deals and member perks need no code).
  2. Open aliexpress.com, add the items you want to your cart and check they meet the offer's terms.
  3. Paste the code into the promo or discount box at checkout and check the price drops before you pay.

• New-user codes only work on a first order with a new account.
  • Check each seller’s delivery estimate, rating and return terms before you buy.
  • In the UK and EU, import VAT is normally charged at checkout on low-value orders.

Tap Get code above to unlock them. Codes can end without notice, so the store's checkout has the final word.

faqs.q: How does VoucherVault check AliExpress codes?
faqs.a: We only list offers we have seen on AliExpress's own site or app, or in its official affiliate feed, and show the date we last checked each one. Offers with a published end date disappear when it passes; offers without one are hidden if we haven't re-checked them recently.

faqs.q: Why isn't my AliExpress code working?
faqs.a: The usual reasons are: the code only covers selected items, you haven't reached a minimum spend, it is for new customers or app orders only, it can't be combined with another offer, or it has just ended. Read the terms on the offer and check your basket meets them.
